after: Nagwa: This gas pipeline is feeding New Capital Power station and it carries the same name like the oil pipeline BL: doesn't exist, Sumed Oil Pipeline does though Checked 2026-11-06: the Petroleum Magazine (Ministry of Petroleum) November 2025 issue, GASCO report on page 55, states that GASCO finished the gas import line from the Sumed port at Ain Sokhna, 32 inch, 6.1 km, and introduced gas on 18 June 2025. A January 2016 World Bank environmental assessment listed an earlier plan for a 32 inch, 4 km Sumed import line from the port to the Sumed valve room for the New Capital power plant, planned for April 2017; that earlier plan is kept as background. The line carries regasified LNG from the port into the national grid; it is not the Sumed crude oil pipeline. Renamed from Sumed Port Gas Pipeline to avoid confusion with the oil pipeline.
